text: Grace Metalious's Peyton Place was banned in Canada in 1956, when Customs officials banned the novel. On 6 December 1957, the original Dell edition was placed on Australia's banned list, where it remained until 11 February 1971. In 1958, Dell Publishing appealed the ban to the Tariff Board, which found the novel had been misclassified as indecent and allowed it into Canada.
meta_description: Peyton Place by Grace Metalious: banned in Canada in 1956, on Australia's banned list from 1957 to 1971; the Tariff Board allowed it into Canada in 1958.
changes: Strict chronology (1956, 1957, 1958); the appeal moved after the Australian listing.
